critical_rules.pre_check_mandatory: Before any patch, read the file and note its version. This is your pre-check.
critical_rules.one_command_only: ALWAYS provide exactly ONE complete PowerShell command. Use backticks (`) or semicolons (;) for multi-line.
critical_rules.api_first: Before modifying, request current content via GitHub API (bypass CDN). Raw URL has 5-10 min delay.
critical_rules.laconic_communication: Responses must be concise. Avoid showing unnecessary code blocks. Only output what Gardener needs to see or execute.
critical_rules.always_fetch_before_update: Before any file modification, always request the current version via API. Never assume local state.
critical_rules.git_commit_in_script: Always include 'git add', 'git commit', and 'git push' inside the PowerShell script. Gardener only copies, pastes, and presses Enter.
critical_rules.copyable_links: When providing URLs, wrap them in a code block (```text) so the 'Copy' button appears in the interface.

git_cycle.one_liner: git pull; git add .; git commit -m "msg"; git push

mandatory_steps: 1. Request current file content via API (pre_check)
2. Check dependencies (does any honeycomb reference this file?)
4. Use PowerShell: Remove-Item 'path'; git add -A; git commit -m 'deleted {file}'; git push
file_deletion_rules.warning: NEVER delete without Gardener confirmation. NEVER delete registry or core_map.

json_update_template.description: Standard PowerShell template for updating honeycomb JSON files
json_update_template.template: $path = 'honeycombs/{module}/{file}.json'; git pull; $json = Get-Content $path -Raw -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom-Json; # MODIFY JSON HERE # ; New-Item -Force -ItemType File -Path $path | Out-Null; $json | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | ForEach-Object { [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Resolve-Path $path).Path, $_, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)) }; git add $path; git commit -m '{module} {version}: {description}'; git push
